MLC LLM is a general compiler and inference engine that deploys language models on GPUs, in browsers through WebGPU, and on iOS and Android behind an OpenAI-compatible API. It has no GUI, browser or device interaction of its own, so it falls outside the computer-use scope.

ms-swift is ModelScope's general framework for fine-tuning, aligning and deploying several hundred language and multimodal models with methods such as SFT, DPO and GRPO. Its README describes no GUI, browser or device interaction; GUI-agent projects mention it only as their training toolkit.

github.com/modelscope/swift is the former name of modelscope/ms-swift: the GitHub API returns the same repository ID, 673412924, for both names. The Claude Agent SDK packages the Claude Code agent loop as a Python and TypeScript library whose built-in tools read and edit files, run shell commands and search the web. The overview lists no graphical, browser or device-control executor, so it is a general agent framework outside the computer-use scope.

Its agents do not operate graphical, browser or device interfaces, so the paper is outside the catalog's computer-use and GUI-agent scope.

Relevance AI is a no-code platform for building sales, marketing, support and operations agents that act through 1,000+ app integrations, evals and governance controls. Its only page interaction comes from optional tool steps for Airtop, a separate browser service that needs its own account, so it is a general agent-builder platform rather than a computer-use resource.

Serper is a commercial API that returns Google search results (web, images, news, maps, places, shopping, scholar and patents) as JSON for programmatic use. It does not open or operate web pages or other interfaces, so it is search-data infrastructure rather than computer or browser use.

Superhighway is a hosted web search API for AI agents whose endpoints return ranked results, news, image links and page text as markdown, sold per call with a free tier. It never renders, clicks or types in a page or app, so it is retrieval infrastructure rather than a computer-use agent, environment or tool.
